id: title:VojtechBartos:offer fix it make no mistakes reply on bug fixes

review.posthog_relevance: Supports the PostHog Slack App's backend response generation, potentially improving the quality of automated replies when users request bug fixes.
review.reason: Adds a specific instruction and negative constraint to the prompt template used by the Slack App to generate reply suggestions. This is a localized change to the suggestion generation prompt, not a systemic reliability or security improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the effectiveness of the new instruction and the behavior of the underlying LLM, which are not demonstrated by this prompt change alone. No runtime behavior or test results are provided.

observations.behavior: Adds a new instruction to the prompt template used for generating Slack reply suggestions. The instruction specifies a fallback label and a specific starting phrase ('Fix it, make no mistakes') for replies that accept a bug fix, while also adding a negative constraint to avoid offering a plain 'Yes, fix it' reply. It also includes a translation instruction for non-English answers.
observations.code_quote: - If the answer offers to fix a bug or an error, use "Fix it, make no mistakes" as the label of the reply \
observations.posthog_connection: This change could help the Slack App backend generate more precise and actionable reply suggestions for users interacting with PostHog support or community channels, potentially improving the quality of automated responses when a user asks for a fix. This is a localized change to the suggestion generation prompt, not a systemic reliability or security improvement.
